title: Is a RM888 Social Media Trial Worth It for a Malaysian Small Business? What You Actually Get (2026)
meta_description: Is a RM888 social media trial worth it for a Malaysian small business? See what the one-time RM888 first-month package includes (1 short video, 2 designs, Meta ad setup), how it compares with RM2,888/month management, and when to skip it.
keywords: is social media management worth it malaysia
meta ads setup malaysia small business
content:
For a Malaysian small business that has never run paid social media, the RM888 first-month trial is worth testing once, as long as you treat it as a test and not a full management plan. It covers one short video, two professional designs and basic Meta ad setup, with a listed value of RM3,100. It can only be used once per company.

## What the RM888 trial actually includes

The trial is a single first-month package priced at RM888 per month. It includes:

- 1 short video
- 2 professional designs
- Basic Meta ad setup

It does not include ongoing posting across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Xiaohongshu. That is what the monthly management packages are for. Read the scope before you pay, because a trial that gives you one video and no posting schedule will feel very different from a full month of content.

## How the trial compares with the full packages

| Package | Price | Short videos | Designs | Scope |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| First-time trial | RM888 per month (once per company) | 1 | 2 | Basic Meta ad setup |
| Social media management | RM2,888 per month | 2 | 5 | Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Xiaohongshu management, plus Meta ad optimisation |
| Full business growth | RM8,888 for 3 months | 6 | 18 | All-channel management including Google Business Profile, Waze, Telegram and Lemon8, plus Meta ad optimisation |

The gap between RM888 and RM2,888 is not just a discount on the same work. The management package adds recurring posting and a second video, so it suits a business that already knows its offer and wants steady output.

## The single-price arithmetic

Cheaper Nexus publishes single-item prices of RM800 per short video and RM150 per design. This is a worked example using those published prices, not a result from any client:

- 1 short video at RM800
- 2 designs at RM150 each, which is RM300
- Total at single-item prices: RM1,100

The trial costs RM888, which leaves a RM212 difference. Basic Meta ad setup is not priced separately, so the difference is the value you place on that setup. If you would pay someone to set up your campaign structure and tracking, the trial is a fair deal. If you already have an ad account and know how to build a campaign, you are paying for the video and designs only, and the arithmetic is less favourable.

## When the trial is worth it

- You have never run Meta ads and want to see whether your offer converts before committing to a monthly budget.
- You have one clear offer with a price and need one video plus creative to test it.
- You want a low-risk first step before considering the RM2,888 monthly package.

## When to skip it

- You need consistent posting every week across several platforms. A one-off trial will not cover that.
- Your offer is not ready. If you have no price, no clear product and no way to take enquiries, any test result will be hard to read.
- You expect ad results within a few days. Meta campaigns need time to settle, so judging after three days usually tells you more about the timing than the campaign.

## How to judge the trial after 30 days

Set your success measures before you start, not after you see the numbers. Useful measures include:

- Cost per enquiry, measured as spend divided by the number of WhatsApp messages or form leads
- Click-through rate on the ad
- The questions people actually ask on WhatsApp, which often reveal whether your offer is clear
- Whether the video produces saves, comments or shares

Use a fixed window, for example 30 days, and a fixed budget. Compare your result against your own previous enquiry numbers, which is a more honest baseline than any industry average. This article does not publish client results, and you should not expect a specific outcome from the trial.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is the RM888 trial really one-time per company?**
Yes. The RM888 first-month package is limited to one use per company. After it, the Social Media Management package is RM2,888 per month, and Meta ad management starts at RM2,000 per month for two pages. Confirm current terms on WhatsApp before you book, because packages can change.

**How much is the trial compared with hiring separately?**
Single-item prices are RM800 per short video and RM150 per design, which comes to RM1,100 for one video and two designs. The RM888 trial bundles those items with basic Meta ad setup, which is not priced separately.

**How long should I run a Meta ad test before deciding?**
Set a fixed window before you start, such as 30 days, and keep the budget steady during that window. Judging a campaign after a few days often reflects the early period rather than the campaign's real performance.

**Does the trial include Google Ads or SEO?**
No. Cheaper Nexus does not offer Google Ads management or SEO services. The trial covers one short video, two designs and basic Meta ad setup.

**What should I prepare before the trial starts?**
Have one clear offer with its price, your product photos or product list, a WhatsApp number that will receive enquiries, and a short description of the customer you want to reach. An unclear offer makes test results hard to read, so settle it first.
